purpose: Clarify the implementation of the frozen Matrix Market duplicate and overflow contract without changing any donor, visit, marker, estimator, comparator, hyperparameter, loss, or promotion rule.

streaming_reduction_contract.body_validation: Read and validate every declared Matrix Market entry through verified gzip EOF, including coordinates outside the retained sufficient statistics.
streaming_reduction_contract.nonnegative_count_certificate: Accumulate the sum of every body value in arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic and require the matrix-wide sum to be at most the signed int64 maximum. Because every value is nonnegative, this proves that every repeated-coordinate sum is int64-representable without materializing the coordinate set.
streaming_reduction_contract.retained_duplicate_accumulation: Sum every retained GEX total, mitochondrial count, RNA panel count, and selected CITE panel count exactly with checked int64 addition. Entry order cannot change any retained sufficient statistic.
streaming_reduction_contract.detected_gene_duplicates: Use one packed presence bit per authorized barcode and GEX feature. Increment detected genes only when a positive entry first sets its coordinate bit; zero and repeated positive entries cannot inflate detected-gene counts.
streaming_reduction_contract.irrelevant_coordinates: Coordinates outside the retained sufficient statistics are validated and included in the matrix-wide nonnegative-count certificate but are not individually materialized or coalesced.
